### MACBOOK AIR SPECIFICATIONS
The latest MacBook Air features the Apple M5 chip. This device exists in 13-inch and 15-inch models. Available colors include Sky Blue, Silver, Starlight, and Midnight. Specifications are located at https://www.apple.com/macbook-air/specs/.

### PRICING AND CONFIGURATIONS
The 13-inch MacBook Air with the M5 chip starts at a price of $1,299. Other configurations cost $1,599 and $1,799.

### CHIP ARCHITECTURE
The Apple M5 chip contains a 10-core CPU with 4 performance cores and 6 efficiency cores. It includes an 8-core GPU, which is configurable to a 10-core GPU. The chip provides hardware-accelerated ray tracing and a 16-core Neural Engine. It delivers 153GB/s memory bandwidth.

### MEDIA ENGINES AND MEMORY
The hardware includes H.264, HEVC, ProRes, and ProRes RAW engines. It supports AV1 decode. The memory is 16GB unified memory, which is configurable.
